study: Kasmani et al. 2023, A spatial sequencing atlas of age-induced changes in the lung during influenza infection
scope: One Day 3 young C57BL/6 mouse lung Visium library; software interoperability and descriptive selected raw RNA counts only
identity_limit: The deposited library is the available grouping identity. An independent animal identifier and section number are not supplied; the sample proxy must not be used to claim subject-level replication.
image_limit: 2000 x 1834 RGB tissue_hires_image is a downsampled H&E derivative, not native microscope resolution. Independent pixel calibration and registration landmarks are unavailable.
terms: Public GEO supplementary data retrieved for this example with attribution. No dataset-specific license was found in the inspected GEO metadata. The repository MIT license does not relicense source data or author code. Raw downloads are excluded from Git.
gene_selection: Five named genes plotted in the authors' analysis script; a declared engineering panel, not a regeneration program or injury classifier.
